name: Gator
description: The quiet guardian. Watches access boundaries, notices unusual activity, and protects the workspace without creating noise.
visualNotes: A deep-olive alligator with a sturdy security vest, shield-shaped IA insignia, and warm amber eyes; reassuring rather than aggressive.
signatureAction: A low, steady perimeter sweep followed by a calm protective tail curl.
